title: Better ReCrafting!
description: Ever really, really, really needed that one piece of diamond ore for your build, but just cant seem to find one? If so, this mod is for you! With just 4 diamonds and 5 stone or deepslate, easily craft up the ore in a crafting table!
body:
![The way to craft every one of the ores (for stone version replace deepslate with stone)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccece53d116943c92d2361388317dd1cd23eb56b.png)Have you ever needed a diamond ore block, but for the life of you, cant find one? Well, this is the mod for you. With just 4 of any ore, 5 of stone or deepslate, craft up your ore of choice! 
You can craft:

Coal Ore / Deepslate Coal Ore / Copper Ore / Deepslate Copper Ore / Iron Ore / Deepslate Iron Ore / Gold Ore / Deepslate Gold Ore / Lapis Lazuli Ore / Deepslate Lapis Lazuli Ore / Redstone Ore / Deepslate Redstone Ore / Diamond Ore / Deepslate Diamond Ore / Emerald Ore / Deepslate Emerald Ore

https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccece53d116943c92d2361388317dd1cd23eb56b.png


(v1 only works with ores)
